name: Truffet · Gremlet #33
description:
A piglet with a mossy back that snuffles out mushrooms nobody else can find.

One of 50 one-of-a-kind Gremlets. Owning this token unlocks Truffet in the Gremlets desktop app, where it walks on your windows, naps, plays with other Gremlets and shows off its signature move.
